skill_name: Compare and contrast the methods used in the two examples
workflow: The two examples describe different methods for repairing an object. In the first example, a car can be repaired by a mechanic, who has specialized knowledge and tools necessary for fixing cars. In the second example, a TV can be repaired by a technician, who likely has specialized knowledge and tools to fix electronics. Both repair specialists may have access to similar tools, but the type of skills and knowledge necessary may be different.
